title: Actual factorable arithmetic input at the polynomial prime boundary
objective: Derive the exact protected-cofactor contribution for actual polynomial-label arithmetic coefficient arrays and decide whether factorability removes the construction obstruction or leaves a genuinely new cancellation obligation, without converting a configuration-space norm into an arithmetic no-go.
deliverables: At most two exact arithmetic candidates
A proved useful connection or precise falsifier at the first load-bearing step
success_criteria: Actual arithmetic coefficient roles and prime boundary remain visible
No configuration-space witness is silently promoted to a factorable-input norm bound
Other cofactor sectors and the full comparison are retained
Any average-in-target result remains distinct from a pointwise Goldbach margin
stop_conditions: One bounded pair round with8 proxy units
No paid inference, publication or external messages
A failed candidate does not relax the original Goldbach objective
